Then the system returns 404

  Scenario: AC20 Replay of a write with the same idempotency key
    Given a write request to a provided operation whose idempotency key was already used for a stored result
    When the same request is sent again with the same idempotency key
    Then the system returns the stored result of the first request
    Then the system writes no further document row, decision log entry or DocumentStored event

  Scenario: AC21 Activity retry and timeout
    Given the matchStep activity of DocumentIntakeWorkflow fails or does not answer within its timeout
    When the activity is retried
    Then the intake item holds one match_status and one document ID
    Then no document row is written twice for the item

  Scenario: AC22 A consumed call fails or does not answer
    Given a consumed contract call to rwb-case or rwb-decision fails or does not answer
    When intake runs
    Then the system writes no document row for that intake item
    Then the intake item stays PENDING for the next run

  Scenario: AC23 A status change the model does not allow is refused
    Given an intake item whose current match_status does not allow the requested status change
    When the status change is requested
    Then the system refuses the request
    Then the item keeps its current match_status
